items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind announces Genie 4 world model with native audio and real-time steering
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind宣布Genie 4世界模型：原生音訊與即時場景操控
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4, a next-generation world model that generates photorealistic interactive environments with native audio (ambient sound, music, dialogue) and allows real-time natural-language steering of scenes. It builds on Gemini Omni for appearance and Gemini models for coherence, and is rolling out as a research preview for trusted testers, with later access planned for Google AI Ultra in Project Genie and early Gemini API partners.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind宣布Genie 4，下一代世界模型，可生成具備原生音訊（環境音、音樂、對話）的擬真互動環境，並支援自然語言即時操控場景。它以Gemini Omni錨定外觀、以其他Gemini模型維持連貫性，目前以研究預覽形式開放給受信任測試者，稍後將開放給Google AI Ultra的Project Genie與Gemini API早期合作夥伴。
items_flat.analysis_en: Genie 4 advances interactive simulation for robotics training, creative tools and agent evaluation, but coherence remains limited to short sessions and object permanence can still drift. Wider availability and measured sim-to-real transfer rates will determine practical impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Genie 4推進了互動模擬在機器人訓練、創意工具與代理評估上的應用，但連貫性仍限於短時段，物件持久性仍可能漂移。更廣泛的可用性與實測sim-to-real遷移率將決定實際影響。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are announcing Genie 4, our new world model, which unlocks unprecedented realism and improves real-time interactive simulation. Genie 4 is natively multimodal, enabling audio-like music, ambient noises, and interactive dialogue to be simultaneously generated with the world.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們宣布Genie 4，我們的新世界模型，它解鎖了前所未有的擬真度並改善即時互動模擬。Genie 4是原生多模態的，能同時生成音樂般的音訊、環境音與互動對話。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic reports early progress accelerating drug development with Claude
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic報告以Claude加速藥物開發的早期進展
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic detailed partnerships with six organizations (including Generate Biomedicines, BigHat, Divergence Labs, Enveda, The Column Group and Bristol Myers Squibb) using Claude across modality design, hit generation, lead optimization, manufacturing paperwork and trial planning. It also acquired one-person Mithril Medicine and began internal programs, including for rare muscular dystrophy, with promising preclinical results in mice.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic詳述與六家機構（含Generate Biomedicines、BigHat、Divergence Labs、Enveda、The Column Group與Bristol Myers Squibb）的合作，使用Claude進行模態設計、命中生成、先導優化、製造文件與試驗規劃。同時收購單人公司Mithril Medicine並啟動內部計畫，包括罕見肌肉萎縮症，小鼠臨床前結果具潛力。
items_flat.analysis_en: The case studies show Claude handling distributed bottlenecks from design to regulatory drafts, but most work remains preclinical. Translating mouse results and operational gains into approved medicines will take years and still depends on model improvements Anthropic says it is prioritizing.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 案例顯示Claude處理從設計到法規草稿的分散瓶頸，但多數仍屬臨床前。將小鼠結果與營運增益轉化為核准藥物仍需多年，且仍取決於Anthropic表示正優先處理的模型改進。
items_flat.quote: Over the past several months, our scientists have engaged in deep research partnerships with six organizations developing new medicines... We've also begun drug discovery efforts of our own.
items_flat.quote_zh: 過去數月，我們的科學家與六家開發新藥的機構進行深度研究合作……我們也開始了自己的藥物發現工作。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic introduces ready-to-use artifacts gallery for Claude for Legal
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic為Claude for Legal推出即用型artifacts法律工具庫
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic launched a gallery of ready-to-use interactive artifacts for Claude for Legal, covering contract review, cite checking, regulatory horizon scans, tabular review and more. Teams can adapt them with their own data and 60+ legal connectors, and share them with guardrails; partner-built tools from firms like Goodwin, Harvey, Foley & Lardner and PwC are included, along with access-to-justice artifacts.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic為Claude for Legal推出即用型互動artifacts工具庫，涵蓋合約審查、引用檢查、法規掃描、表格審查等。團隊可用自有資料與60多個法律連接器調整，並在防護下分享；包含Goodwin、Harvey、Foley & Lardner、PwC等合作夥伴工具，以及司法可及性artifacts。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move shifts Claude from pure chat toward structured legal workflows, addressing common requests for easier collaboration. Success depends on how well artifacts reduce review time without introducing new privilege or accuracy risks in high-stakes work.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉將Claude從純對話轉向結構化法律工作流，回應常見的協作需求。成敗取決於artifacts能否縮短審查時間，同時不在高風險工作中引入新的特權或準確性風險。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing ready-to-use artifacts that legal professionals can adapt to how their teams work and share with colleagues across the business.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出法律專業人士可依團隊工作方式調整、並與企業同事分享的即用型artifacts。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic expands GSA partnership with 40% discount for all levels of US government
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic擴大GSA合作，為美國各級政府提供40%折扣
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic expanded its GSA agreement to offer a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government and the Claude API across federal, state, local, tribal and territorial governments, with no minimum spend. Roughly 500 government organizations already use Claude; weekly active users in Claude for Government are up about eightfold since February.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic擴大GSA協議，對聯邦、州、地方、部落與領地政府提供Claude Enterprise、Claude for Government與Claude API 40%折扣，無最低消費。約500個政府組織已使用Claude；Claude for Government每週活躍用戶自2月以來約增八倍。
items_flat.analysis_en: The discount lowers barriers for public-sector adoption amid long procurement cycles and tight budgets, but actual uptake still depends on security authorizations and agency implementation capacity.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 折扣降低了公共部門在冗長採購週期與緊縮預算下的採用門檻，但實際採用仍取決於安全授權與機構執行能力。
items_flat.quote: We are expanding our partnership with the General Services Administration (GSA) through a new agreement that gives government partners a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government, and the Claude API.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們透過新協議擴大與總務署（GSA）的合作，給予政府合作夥伴在Claude Enterprise、Claude for Government與Claude API上40%的折扣。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI expands Oracle partnership to bring apps and data into ChatGPT
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI擴大Oracle合作，將應用與資料帶入ChatGPT
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI and Oracle announced an expansion that will bring Oracle applications and data into ChatGPT via Oracle AI Workspace (in development), while powering new Oracle offerings such as AI Security Mesh, an SMB Bundle with ChatGPT Business and Codex, and App Composer. US Oracle customers can also purchase OpenAI API, Codex and ChatGPT Work through Oracle Marketplace.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI與Oracle宣布擴大合作，將透過開發中的Oracle AI Workspace把Oracle應用與資料帶入ChatGPT，同時以OpenAI模型驅動Oracle AI Security Mesh、含ChatGPT Business與Codex的SMB套件，以及App Composer。美國Oracle客戶亦可透過Oracle Marketplace購買OpenAI API、Codex與ChatGPT Work。
items_flat.analysis_en: The deal deepens enterprise distribution for ChatGPT and Codex inside existing Oracle procurement flows, but Oracle AI Workspace remains in development and the practical depth of data/workflow integration is still to be proven.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此協議深化ChatGPT與Codex在既有Oracle採購流程中的企業分銷，但Oracle AI Workspace仍在開發中，資料與工作流整合的實際深度尚待驗證。
items_flat.quote: OpenAI and Oracle are bringing Oracle applications and data into ChatGPT and powering new Oracle products and services with OpenAI models and products.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI與Oracle正將Oracle應用與資料帶入ChatGPT，並以OpenAI模型與產品驅動新的Oracle產品與服務。

items_flat.title_en: Gemini Robotics Embodied Reasoning 2 enters public preview on Google Cloud
items_flat.title_zh: Gemini Robotics Embodied Reasoning 2在Google Cloud公開預覽
items_flat.summary_en: Google Cloud made Gemini Robotics Embodied Reasoning 2 (ER 2) available in public preview on the Gemini platform. The specialized model serves as a high-level robot brain for spatial-temporal reasoning, long-horizon planning, self-correction and multi-robot orchestration across embodiments, with enterprise security and lifecycle management.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google Cloud將Gemini Robotics Embodied Reasoning 2（ER 2）在Gemini平台以公開預覽開放。此專用模型作為機器人高階大腦，提供時空推理、長程規劃、自我修正與跨形態多機器人編排，並搭配企業級安全與生命週期管理。
items_flat.analysis_en: Putting a frontier embodied-reasoning model into production cloud tooling lowers the barrier for enterprise physical AI, but real-world reliability, safety guardrail performance and cost still need broader validation beyond research demos.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將前沿具身推理模型放入生產級雲端工具降低了企業實體AI的門檻，但真實世界可靠性、安全防護表現與成本仍需超越研究演示的更廣泛驗證。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are bringing this same frontier embodied reasoning model to enterprise production environments: Gemini Robotics ER 2 is now available in public preview on the Gemini platform.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們將同一套前沿具身推理模型帶入企業生產環境：Gemini Robotics ER 2現已在Gemini平台公開預覽。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA invests $3 billion in Meta and expands collaboration on Muse agents
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA投資Meta 30億美元並擴大Muse代理合作
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA and Meta announced an expanded partnership on Muse and the Muse family of models to improve inference and training performance, alongside a $3 billion NVIDIA investment in Meta’s equity offering. Meta plans to expand deployment of NVIDIA Vera Rubin systems, Vera CPUs, Spectrum-X networking and BlueField-4; the companies may also explore OpenShell and Sentry for agent security.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA與Meta宣布擴大在Muse及Muse模型家族上的合作，以改善推論與訓練效能，並由NVIDIA投資Meta股權發行30億美元。Meta計畫擴大部署NVIDIA Vera Rubin系統、Vera CPU、Spectrum-X網路與BlueField-4；雙方亦可能探索OpenShell與Sentry以強化代理安全。
items_flat.analysis_en: The deal ties capital, hardware and model optimization together for Meta’s personal-agent push, but it is part of a larger equity raise and does not by itself change Muse’s current availability or measured capabilities.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此協議將資本、硬體與模型優化綁在一起，支持Meta的個人代理推進，但它是更大規模股權融資的一部分，本身並未改變Muse目前的可用性或已測能力。
items_flat.quote: NVIDIA and Meta today announced they will partner to expand their work on Muse and the Muse family of models to improve inference and training performance... In addition, NVIDIA will invest $3 billion in Meta’s equity offering.
items_flat.quote_zh: NVIDIA與Meta今天宣布將合作擴大在Muse及Muse模型家族上的工作，以改善推論與訓練效能……此外，NVIDIA將投資Meta股權發行30億美元。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral launches Responses API in public preview for agent building
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral以公開預覽推出Responses API供建構代理
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral introduced the Responses API in public preview, returning the model’s answer, reasoning and tool calls as separate items to make agent construction easier than Chat Completions. It works with all Mistral-hosted chat models including Large 4, and is served on Mistral AI Cloud Inference in the EU and US.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral以公開預覽推出Responses API，將模型答案、推理與工具呼叫作為獨立項目返回，使代理建構比Chat Completions更容易。它適用於所有Mistral託管的聊天模型（含Large 4），並在歐盟與美國的Mistral AI Cloud Inference上提供。
items_flat.analysis_en: Aligning with the OpenAI Responses format lowers switching cost for agent developers, but the preview is still stateless and early; production readiness and parity with larger labs’ agent tooling remain to be shown.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 對齊OpenAI Responses格式降低了代理開發者的切換成本，但預覽仍是無狀態且早期；生產就緒度與與較大實驗室代理工具的對等性仍待證明。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing the Responses API in public preview, made for building agents on Mistral. Each response returns the model’s answer, its reasoning and its tool calls as separate items...
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們以公開預覽推出Responses API，專為在Mistral上建構代理而設計。每次回應將模型答案、推理與工具呼叫作為獨立項目返回……

meta.title_en: NVIDIA invests $3 billion in Meta and expands collaboration on Muse agents
meta.title_zh: NVIDIA投資Meta 30億美元並擴大Muse代理合作
meta.summary_en: NVIDIA and Meta announced an expanded partnership on Muse and the Muse family of models to improve inference and training performance, alongside a $3 billion NVIDIA investment in Meta’s equity offering. Meta plans to expand deployment of NVIDIA Vera Rubin systems, Vera CPUs, Spectrum-X networking and BlueField-4; the companies may also explore OpenShell and Sentry for agent security.
meta.summary_zh: NVIDIA與Meta宣布擴大在Muse及Muse模型家族上的合作，以改善推論與訓練效能，並由NVIDIA投資Meta股權發行30億美元。Meta計畫擴大部署NVIDIA Vera Rubin系統、Vera CPU、Spectrum-X網路與BlueField-4；雙方亦可能探索OpenShell與Sentry以強化代理安全。
meta.analysis_en: The deal ties capital, hardware and model optimization together for Meta’s personal-agent push, but it is part of a larger equity raise and does not by itself change Muse’s current availability or measured capabilities.
meta.analysis_zh: 此協議將資本、硬體與模型優化綁在一起，支持Meta的個人代理推進，但它是更大規模股權融資的一部分，本身並未改變Muse目前的可用性或已測能力。
meta.quote: NVIDIA and Meta today announced they will partner to expand their work on Muse and the Muse family of models to improve inference and training performance... In addition, NVIDIA will invest $3 billion in Meta’s equity offering.
meta.quote_zh: NVIDIA與Meta今天宣布將合作擴大在Muse及Muse模型家族上的工作，以改善推論與訓練效能……此外，NVIDIA將投資Meta股權發行30億美元。

frontier_other.title_en: Mistral launches Responses API in public preview for agent building
frontier_other.title_zh: Mistral以公開預覽推出Responses API供建構代理
frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral introduced the Responses API in public preview, returning the model’s answer, reasoning and tool calls as separate items to make agent construction easier than Chat Completions. It works with all Mistral-hosted chat models including Large 4, and is served on Mistral AI Cloud Inference in the EU and US.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral以公開預覽推出Responses API，將模型答案、推理與工具呼叫作為獨立項目返回，使代理建構比Chat Completions更容易。它適用於所有Mistral託管的聊天模型（含Large 4），並在歐盟與美國的Mistral AI Cloud Inference上提供。
frontier_other.analysis_en: Aligning with the OpenAI Responses format lowers switching cost for agent developers, but the preview is still stateless and early; production readiness and parity with larger labs’ agent tooling remain to be shown.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 對齊OpenAI Responses格式降低了代理開發者的切換成本，但預覽仍是無狀態且早期；生產就緒度與與較大實驗室代理工具的對等性仍待證明。
frontier_other.quote: Today, we’re introducing the Responses API in public preview, made for building agents on Mistral. Each response returns the model’s answer, its reasoning and its tool calls as separate items...
frontier_other.quote_zh: 今天，我們以公開預覽推出Responses API，專為在Mistral上建構代理而設計。每次回應將模型答案、推理與工具呼叫作為獨立項目返回……

brief_en: Labs focused on agents, robotics and domain tools: Google shipped Genie 4 world model and Robotics ER 2 on Cloud; Anthropic added legal artifacts, drug-development case studies and a 40% government discount; OpenAI expanded Oracle integration; Meta-NVIDIA deepened Muse partnership with $3B investment; Mistral previewed a Responses API.
brief_zh: 大廠聚焦代理、機器人與垂直工具：Google推出Genie 4世界模型與雲端機器人ER 2；Anthropic新增法律artifacts、藥物研發案例與政府40%折扣；OpenAI擴大Oracle整合；Meta與NVIDIA深化Muse合作並投資30億美元；Mistral預覽Responses API。
